<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Disclosure

AI assistance was used. The changes were reviewed and tested manually.

## Overview

**Splits the fused MUSE-Spark op on one item - `head_dim` (64/128/256), the whole op having landed in #62132 five days ago.**

`csrc/fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_kernel.cu` holds the whole fused MUSE-Spark qknorm/rope/kv-insert op: its host entry dispatches `head_dim` x `heads_per_group` x rope type, so 18 kernel instantiations land in a single translation unit. On a 9-arch build that unit is one of the longest compiles of the build - 478 s, behind only the int4 skinny GEMM (1232 s).

This PR instantiates one unit per `head_dim` (64/128/256): the kernels move into an include-only `fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_kernel.cuh` whose entry is a template over `HEAD_DIM`, each unit is two lines (`#include` + `VLLM_MUSE_SPARK_ENTRY(, hd)`), and `fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_api.cu` keeps the public symbol and dispatches on `head_dim`, `extern template` keeping the device code in the three units.

Same kernels, same dispatch rules, same numerics: the only change is which translation unit generates which `head_dim`, plus the runtime forward in the API unit. At 1 arch the file is not the build's tail, so the single-arch wall is unchanged.

**This one only pays off once the int4 unit is split** (#63364): while that 1232 s unit exists it is the tail regardless of what this op costs, so on `main` alone this PR is expected to be neutral. The 9-arch numbers below are therefore measured on top of the int4 split.

The single-arch rows are `pip install -e .` on MI350 (gfx950); the 9-arch row is the `setup.py bdist_wheel` described under *Validation*. All cold builds:

| build | `main` | this PR | All 5 PRs (#62921) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `MAX_JOBS=16`, gfx950 only | 107 s | 108 s | 87 s |
| `MAX_JOBS=64`, gfx950 only | 85 s | 87 s | 50 s |
| `MAX_JOBS=64`, 9 archs | 1263 s | 1241 s | 472 s |

## Claims

- Removes the second-longest compile of the 9-arch build (478 s, one unit) by instantiating one unit per `head_dim`: 3 units of the same total device code.
- Only pays off once the int4 unit is split; on `main` alone the 1232 s int4 unit stays the tail, so this PR is measured on top of #63364.
- Single-arch is unchanged within noise (107 -> 108 s at 16 jobs, 85 -> 87 s at 64).
- The op is not re-instantiated or reduced: each lane emits its `head_dim` arm's 18 configurations (2 dtypes x 3 heads_per_group x 2 rope types) exactly as before.
- One entry template with one explicit instantiation per `head_dim`, i.e. three distinct symbols; specialising a shared body by macro instead made the linker keep one copy and fail `head_dim` 128/256 at runtime.

### Why five PRs

The two builds are bound by different things, so no single change moves both.

**Why the three single-arch PRs are all needed.** At 1 arch (`gfx950`, `MAX_JOBS=64`, `main` = 85 s) three groups take turns setting the wall, in this order:

1. topk softplus-sqrt (#62717) - 74.5 s, a single unit
2. paged attention (#62716) - 71.6 s, the slowest of 12 units
3. other skinny GEMMs (#62718) - 40.9 s, a single unit

#62717 takes (1) to 7.4 s, #62716 takes (2) to 31.1 s and #62718 stops (3) from becoming the next tail; with all three the tail moves to `selective_scan_fwd` (37.7 s) and the build goes from 85 s to 49 s. Drop any one of them and a ~70 s unit is back at the top, so the single-arch win needs all three.

**Why that is not enough at 9 archs.** A 9-arch build multiplies every unit's time by ~9, and the tail becomes two files that none of the first three touch: `csrc/rocm/skinny_gemms_int4.cu` at 1232 s and `csrc/fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_kernel.cu` at 478 s. All three merged take the 9-arch build from 1263 s to only 1253 s. #63364 splits the first (its tail drops to 448 s) and #63365 the second (to 171 s), which is what reaches 472 s.

The `skinny_gemms_int4.cu` tail is invisible in a `gfx950` build because that file **only emits its kernels for RDNA (that is part of the 9-arch build)**:

https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/f4edf9f0f078ae67392510aafd1871288948a3c3/csrc/rocm/skinny_gemms_int4.cu#L17-L19
https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/f4edf9f0f078ae67392510aafd1871288948a3c3/csrc/rocm/skinny_gemms_int4.cu#L568-L579

`csrc/fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_kernel.cu` fails differently: it has no arch guard, so a `gfx950` build compiles it for real - it is just 25 s there against 478 s across nine archs, which is why a single-arch profile ranks it as irrelevant (#63365).

| slowest unit per group, 1 arch (`MAX_JOBS=64`) | `main` | all 5 |
|---|---|---|
| topk softplus-sqrt | 74.5 s | 7.4 s |
| paged attention | 71.6 s | 31.1 s |
| other skinny GEMMs | 40.9 s | 31.6 s |
| `selective_scan_fwd` | 36.5 s | 37.7 s |
| MUSE-Spark | 25.0 s | 10.9 s |
| int4 skinny GEMM | 19.4 s | 17.5 s |
| **wall / average parallelism** | **76 s / 15.8x** | **39 s / 30.2x** |

| slowest unit per group, 9 archs (`MAX_JOBS=64`) | `main` | all 5 |
|---|---|---|
| int4 skinny GEMM | 1232 s | 448 s |
| MUSE-Spark | 478 s | 171 s |
| `selective_scan_fwd` | 288 s | 296 s |
| paged attention | 284 s | 286 s |
| other skinny GEMMs | not recorded | 247 s |
| topk softplus-sqrt | not recorded | 99 s |
| **wall / average parallelism** | **1234 s / 8.7x** | **472 s / 25x** |

## Validation

### Single arch build

```bash
PYTORCH_ROCM_ARCH="gfx950" VLLM_DISABLE_SCCACHE=1 MAX_JOBS=N \
  pip install --no-cache-dir -e . --no-deps --no-build-isolation
```

 gfx950, cold builds in the same container:

| build | `MAX_JOBS=16` | `MAX_JOBS=64` |
|---|---|---|
| baseline (`main`, `f4edf9f0f0`) | 107 s | 85 s |
| #62716 paged attention 089bbaf68a | 92 s (−14 %) | 86 s (≈0 %) |
| #62717 topk softplus-sqrt 114a66d0f5 | 107 s (≈0 %) | 85 s (≈0 %) |
| #62718 skinny GEMMs 78a62ceb1c | 110 s (+3 %) | 85 s (≈0 %) |
| #63364 int4 skinny GEMM 6271426e4f | 109 s (+2 %) | 87 s (+2 %) |
| **this PR** (`31de254fe4`) | 108 s (+1 %) | 87 s (+2 %) |
| All 5 PRs (#62921) e9f5601585 | 87 s (−19 %) | 50 s (−41 %) |

### 9 archs build

The multi-arch wheel build with the 9 release archs of `docker/Dockerfile.rocm_base`, mold as the linker and sccache disabled, from a cleared tree (`vllm/*.so`, `build/` and `dist/` removed first):

```bash
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 LDFLAGS="-fuse-ld=mold" \
  PYTORCH_ROCM_ARCH="gfx90a;gfx942;gfx950;gfx1100;gfx1101;gfx1200;gfx1201;gfx1150;gfx1151" \
  VLLM_DISABLE_SCCACHE=1 MAX_JOBS=64 \
  python3 setup.py bdist_wheel --dist-dir=dist
```

| build | wall time | wheel |
|---|---|---|
| `main` (`f4edf9f0f0`) | **1263 s** | **266 MB** |
| #62716 paged attention 089bbaf68a | 1261 s | 275 MB |
| #62717 topk softplus-sqrt 114a66d0f5 | 1243 s | 269 MB |
| #62718 skinny GEMMs 78a62ceb1c | 1248 s | 266 MB |
| #63364 int4 skinny GEMM 6271426e4f | **600 s (−52 %)** | **257 MB** |
| **this PR** (`31de254fe4`) | **1241 s (−2 %)** | **266 MB** |
| All 5 PRs (#62921) e9f5601585 | **472 s (−63 %)** | **270 MB** |

Per-unit detail at this configuration:

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| MUSE-Spark unit | 478 s, one unit | 3 units of the same total device code |
| `fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_api.cu` | - | 27 lines, no device code |

Environment, one host: AMD EPYC 9575F (64 cores / 256 threads), 8x AMD Instinct MI350X (251 GiB each), ROCm 10.0, `torch 2.12.0+rocm10.0.0`, clang 23, mold.

Structure check on the 9-arch objects: the API unit emits 0 device kernel symbols and each of the three lane units 240 - i.e. each unit instantiates only its own `head_dim`.

#### Linked artifact sizes at 9 archs

Context for these: [#62983](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/62983) had to revert #62475 because the 9-arch `_rocm_C.abi3.so` outgrew the 2 GiB reach of the 32-bit PC-relative relocations in `crtbegin`'s `.text` (plain `main` was already at 2011.5 MiB, and the 12-way split added ~119 MiB of duplicated GPU debug info, overflowing at 2104 MiB). `--offload-compress`, which landed with the reland (#63105), shrinks the fatbin ~20x and is what keeps us away from that wall.

| linked artifact (9 archs) | `main` | this PR | All 5 PRs (#62921) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `_rocm_C.abi3.so` | TBD | **125.9 MB** | **129.3 MB** |
| `_C_stable_libtorch.abi3.so` | TBD | **499.8 MB** | **499.8 MB** |
| `_moe_C_stable_libtorch.abi3.so` | TBD | **235.2 MB** | **239.8 MB** |
| `_C.abi3.so` | TBD | **30.7 MB** | **30.0 MB** |
| `.o` files under `CMakeFiles/` | TBD | **935 MB** | **932 MB** |

The split does not add device code - it moves the same `head_dim` arm's kernels into different units - so the 9-arch `_rocm_C` stays where `main` puts it, and across the five PRs the wheel is about the same size (266 -> 270 MB).

### Runtime check

The existing kernel test file covers `head_dim` 64/128/256 through the public entry, i.e. through the new forward, and was run on both builds of `bdc0f947` (each a fresh `MAX_JOBS=64 pip install -e . --no-deps --no-build-isolation`; the later `main` merge does not touch these files):

```bash
python -m pytest tests/kernels/test_fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert.py
```

```
29 passed, 2 skipped in 15.74s      # CUDA, 8x H100, cu134 nightly
26 passed, 5 deselected in 10.01s   # ROCm, MI350X/gfx950, -k "not attention_metadata"
```

The 2 CUDA skips are ROCm-only cases (backend gate, compile boundary). The 5 ROCm deselects are `test_query_fusion_respects_attention_metadata`, which import `flashinfer` and were absent from that container only; they are among the 29 that pass on CUDA. The split builds and runs on both paths, and each `head_dim` gets its own `..._typed<hd>` instantiation.

## Details

The kernel is untouched: the `__global__` template and the `DISPATCH_ARGS`/`DISPATCH_HPG`/`DISPATCH_ROPE_T` tower are unchanged. What changed is how the `head_dim` arm is selected - `HEAD_DIM` is a template parameter of `launchFusedMuseSpark`, so the runtime `switch (head_dim)` is a single `DISPATCH_ROPE_T(HEAD_DIM)` and each unit's symbols carry their own head_dim - plus the API unit dispatching to `..._typed<64/128/256>`. A `head_dim` outside 64/128/256 still reports "unsupported head_dim".

**How the file got this big.** It has no growth history: #62132 landed the whole op five days ago, in one TU, as 1 `__global__` with 8 templates and `head_dim` {64,128,256} x `heads_per_group` {1,2,4} x rope type {fp32, scalar_t} - 18 configurations per dtype pair, plus the fp8-output arms. Nothing has been added to it since.

So its 478 s at 9 archs is the cost of that configuration set on day one, not of accretion; this PR splits it into 3 units.

### Left to do

- [ ] Cross-check with #63364: this branch is based on `main`, so its 9-arch numbers are taken with the int4 split merged in; on `main` alone the change is neutral (1241 s vs 1263 s).
- [x] Run `tests/kernels/test_fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert.py` on this revision (it covers head_dim 64/128/256 through the public entry, i.e. through the new forward). Done, see *Runtime check*.

### PR Pundit review

(Testing PR Pundit Code Review agent. Not all comments may be relevant. This is a one-time automated pass: please address what is useful, no need to request a re-review. Reach out to @peymanr for suggestions and feedback.)

| # | | Finding | Where |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 🔴 | Lane-dependent template body risks ODR violation across units | `csrc/fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_kernel.cu:579` |
| 2 | 🟠 | No single-process test covers all three head_dims on split build | `tests/kernels/test_fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert.py:251` |
| 3 | 🔵 | Op signature hand-duplicated with no shared declaration | `csrc/fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_api.cu:12` |
| 4 | 🔵 | Dead LANE==0 fallback path is never built or validated | `csrc/fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_kernel.cu:576` |
| 5 | 🔵 | Include-only kernel keeps .cu extension and public symbol | `csrc/fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_kernel.cu` |
| 6 | 🔵 | Macro name `LANE` misdescribes head-dim selection | `csrc/fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_kernel.cu:575` |

#### 1. 🔴 Blocking: Lane-dependent template body risks ODR violation across units
`csrc/fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_kernel.cu:579`

`launchFusedMuseSpark<scalar_t,...>` has external linkage (not in the anonymous namespace) and its `if constexpr` body varies per TU via `FUSED_MUSE_SPARK_LANE`, so the linker keeps one arbitrary weak copy for all three suffixed entry points. Two of three head_dims may hit `STD_TORCH_CHECK(false, "head_dim N not compiled")` depending on link order and inlining. Make the function depend on `head_dim` as a template parameter or place it in an anonymous namespace.

**How it is reached:** MuseSpark model forward (vllm/models/muse_spark/amd/model.py:588, gated at :545-554 on head_dim in (64,128,256), bf16/fp16, supported kv cache) or tests/kernels/test_fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert.py -> vllm._custom_ops.fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert -> torch.ops._C op -> _api.cu switch -> fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_hd{128,256} -> vllm::muse_spark_fused_ops::launchFusedMuseSpark<st,CACHE_T,KV_DTYPE> (weak symbol, linker keeps one lane's copy, likely hd64 by CMake order) -> STD_TORCH_CHECK(false, "head_dim N not compiled") at kernel.cu:579+

**Who is affected:** Every CUDA or ROCm build of _C: the fused MuseSpark op fails at runtime for every head_dim whose lane copy the linker dropped (two of 64/128/256), so the MuseSpark model's fused path and the kernel tests break.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

#### 2. 🟠 Should fix: No single-process test covers all three head_dims on split build
`tests/kernels/test_fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert.py:251`

`launchFusedMuseSpark<scalar_t, cache_t, kv_dt>` is now implicitly instantiated with a different, `FUSED_MUSE_SPARK_LANE`-dependent body in each of `_hd64`/`_hd128`/`_hd256`.cu under one mangled name. Unless it is inlined, the linker keeps one body, and the other head_dims hit `head_dim N not compiled` at runtime. Only `test_fused_query_quant_matches_separate_quant` covers head_dim 128/256; the other tests use `HEAD_DIM=64`. That test is skipped on ROCm GPUs whose `fp8_dtype()` is FNUZ (gfx942/MI300), so there a broken build passes the whole file. Add head_dim 64/128/256 (and an unsupported head_dim) coverage that does not depend on E4M3FN Q output, or give the lane functions internal linkage.

**Who is affected:** ROCm FNUZ GPUs (MI300/gfx942) running this test file; on CUDA and E4M3FN ROCm the line-251 test still covers all three head_dims.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

**Related past reviews:** [#42893](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/42893) on `csrc/fused_deepseek_v4_qnorm_rope_kv_insert_kernel.cu`

#### 3. 🔵 Nit: Op signature hand-duplicated with no shared declaration
`csrc/fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_api.cu:12`

`fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_api.cu` hand-copies the 16-parameter op signature four times (three `_hdN` prototypes plus the entry definition) and does not include `csrc/ops.h`, which already declares the entry. If the signature changes in `kernel.cu`/`ops.h` but not here, a mismatch just creates a different C++ overload. The error then appears only when the `_hdN` or `torch_bindings.cpp` symbol is resolved (link, or `vllm._C` import), not at compile time. The `#define`-before-`#include` renaming in each `hdN.cu` is confined to that unit and does not touch vLLM's `ops.h` (`kernel.cu` includes only torch's `stable/ops.h`). Consider sharing one parameter-list macro or including `ops.h`, as `csrc/rocm/attention_dispatch.cu` does with `ATTN_ENTRY`.

**Who is affected:** Developers who later change this op's signature; no runtime effect on users of the current code.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

#### 4. 🔵 Nit: Dead LANE==0 fallback path is never built or validated
`csrc/fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_kernel.cu:576`

The `FUSED_MUSE_SPARK_LANE` default-0 fallback, the `LANE == 0 ||` guard clauses, and the comment describe a mode the build never uses, and a typo'd macro silently compiles a TU rejecting every head_dim at runtime. Replace the fallback with `#ifndef ... #error` at file scope, add a `static_assert`, and drop the `== 0 ||` clauses.

**Who is affected:** Maintainers of the MUSE-Spark kernel sources; no runtime effect in any shipped build configuration.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

**Related past reviews:** [#37503](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/37503) on `CMakeLists.txt`

#### 5. 🔵 Nit: Include-only kernel keeps .cu extension and public symbol
`csrc/fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_kernel.cu`

The now include-only kernel file keeps its `.cu` extension and still defines the unsuffixed `fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert`; re-adding it to a source list would duplicate that symbol. Rename it to `.cuh` or add `#error` when `FUSED_MUSE_SPARK_LANE` is undefined, matching the attention split.

**Who is affected:** Only a future maintainer who adds `csrc/fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_kernel.cu` back to a CMake source list; today's build is unaffected.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

**Related past reviews:** [#37376](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/37376) on `csrc/fused_qknorm_rope_kernel.cu`

#### 6. 🔵 Nit: Macro name `LANE` misdescribes head-dim selection
`csrc/fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_kernel.cu:575`

`FUSED_MUSE_SPARK_LANE` misuses 'lane', which elsewhere (`ELTS_PER_LANE`, etc.) means a thread within a warp; here it selects the head_dim the TU instantiates. Rename to something like `FUSED_MUSE_SPARK_HEAD_DIM` to match the `_hd<n>` suffixes and CMake comment.

**Who is affected:** Maintainers reading or extending the per-head_dim split of the fused MUSE-Spark op; it has no runtime or build effect.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

<sub>Shared from a pilot of [PR Pundit](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/pr_pundit), an agentic code reviewer that builds and tests the change and reads the project's past reviews. Reviewed at `31de254f`; findings checked and posted by @peymanr; points already raised on this PR are left out.</sub>

## Claude Code Review

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.

| MUSE-Spark | 25.0 s | 10.9 s |
| int4 skinny GEMM | 19.4 s | 17.5 s |
| **wall / average parallelism** | **76 s / 15.8x** | **39 s / 30.2x** |

| slowest unit per group, 9 archs (`MAX_JOBS=64`) | `main` | all 5 |
|---|---|---|
| int4 skinny GEMM | 1232 s | 448 s |
| MUSE-Spark | 478 s | 171 s |
| `selective_scan_fwd` | 288 s | 296 s |
| paged attention | 284 s | 286 s |
| other skinny GEMMs | not recorded | 247 s |
| topk softplus-sqrt | not recorded | 99 s |
| **wall / average parallelism** | **1234 s / 8.7x** | **472 s / 25x** |

## Validation

### Single arch build

```bash
PYTORCH_ROCM_ARCH="gfx950" VLLM_DISABLE_SCCACHE=1 MAX_JOBS=N \
  pip install --no-cache-dir -e . --no-deps --no-build-isolation
```

 gfx950, cold builds in the same container:

| build | `MAX_JOBS=16` | `MAX_JOBS=64` |
|---|---|---|
| baseline (`main`, `f4edf9f0f0`) | 107 s | 85 s |
| #62716 paged attention 089bbaf68a | 92 s (−14 %) | 86 s (≈0 %) |
| #62717 topk softplus-sqrt 114a66d0f5 | 107 s (≈0 %) | 85 s (≈0 %) |
| #62718 skinny GEMMs 78a62ceb1c | 110 s (+3 %) | 85 s (≈0 %) |
| #63364 int4 skinny GEMM 6271426e4f | 109 s (+2 %) | 87 s (+2 %) |
| **this PR** (`31de254fe4`) | 108 s (+1 %) | 87 s (+2 %) |
| All 5 PRs (#62921) e9f5601585 | 87 s (−19 %) | 50 s (−41 %) |

### 9 archs build

The multi-arch wheel build with the 9 release archs of `docker/Dockerfile.rocm_base`, mold as the linker and sccache disabled, from a cleared tree (`vllm/*.so`, `build/` and `dist/` removed first):

```bash
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 LDFLAGS="-fuse-ld=mold" \
  PYTORCH_ROCM_ARCH="gfx90a;gfx942;gfx950;gfx1100;gfx1101;gfx1200;gfx1201;gfx1150;gfx1151" \
  VLLM_DISABLE_SCCACHE=1 MAX_JOBS=64 \
  python3 setup.py bdist_wheel --dist-dir=dist
```

| build | wall time | wheel |
|---|---|---|
| `main` (`f4edf9f0f0`) | **1263 s** | **266 MB** |
| #62716 paged attention 089bbaf68a | 1261 s | 275 MB |
| #62717 topk softplus-sqrt 114a66d0f5 | 1243 s | 269 MB |
| #62718 skinny GEMMs 78a62ceb1c | 1248 s | 266 MB |
| #63364 int4 skinny GEMM 6271426e4f | **600 s (−52 %)** | **257 MB** |
| **this PR** (`31de254fe4`) | **1241 s (−2 %)** | **266 MB** |
| All 5 PRs (#62921) e9f5601585 | **472 s (−63 %)** | **270 MB** |

Per-unit detail at this configuration:

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| MUSE-Spark unit | 478 s, one unit | 3 units of the same total device code |
| `fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_api.cu` | - | 27 lines, no device code |

Environment, one host: AMD EPYC 9575F (64 cores / 256 threads), 8x AMD Instinct MI350X (251 GiB each), ROCm 10.0, `torch 2.12.0+rocm10.0.0`, clang 23, mold.

Structure check on the 9-arch objects: the API unit emits 0 device kernel symbols and each of the three lane units 240 - i.e. each unit instantiates only its own `head_dim`.

#### Linked artifact sizes at 9 archs

Context for these: [#62983](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/62983) had to revert #62475 because the 9-arch `_rocm_C.abi3.so` outgrew the 2 GiB reach of the 32-bit PC-relative relocations in `crtbegin`'s `.text` (plain `main` was already at 2011.5 MiB, and the 12-way split added ~119 MiB of duplicated GPU debug info, overflowing at 2104 MiB). `--offload-compress`, which landed with the reland (#63105), shrinks the fatbin ~20x and is what keeps us away from that wall.

| linked artifact (9 archs) | `main` | this PR | All 5 PRs (#62921) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `_rocm_C.abi3.so` | TBD | **125.9 MB** | **129.3 MB** |
| `_C_stable_libtorch.abi3.so` | TBD | **499.8 MB** | **499.8 MB** |
| `_moe_C_stable_libtorch.abi3.so` | TBD | **235.2 MB** | **239.8 MB** |
| `_C.abi3.so` | TBD | **30.7 MB** | **30.0 MB** |
| `.o` files under `CMakeFiles/` | TBD | **935 MB** | **932 MB** |

The split does not add device code - it moves the same `head_dim` arm's kernels into different units - so the 9-arch `_rocm_C` stays where `main` puts it, and across the five PRs the wheel is about the same size (266 -> 270 MB).

### Runtime check

The existing kernel test file covers `head_dim` 64/128/256 through the public entry, i.e. through the new forward, and was run on both builds of `bdc0f947` (each a fresh `MAX_JOBS=64 pip install -e . --no-deps --no-build-isolation`; the later `main` merge does not touch these files):

```bash
python -m pytest tests/kernels/test_fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert.py
```

```
29 passed, 2 skipped in 15.74s      # CUDA, 8x H100, cu134 nightly
26 passed, 5 deselected in 10.01s   # ROCm, MI350X/gfx950, -k "not attention_metadata"
```

The 2 CUDA skips are ROCm-only cases (backend gate, compile boundary). The 5 ROCm deselects are `test_query_fusion_respects_attention_metadata`, which import `flashinfer` and were absent from that container only; they are among the 29 that pass on CUDA. The split builds and runs on both paths, and each `head_dim` gets its own `..._typed<hd>` instantiation.

## Details

The kernel is untouched: the `__global__` template and the `DISPATCH_ARGS`/`DISPATCH_HPG`/`DISPATCH_ROPE_T` tower are unchanged. What changed is how the `head_dim` arm is selected - `HEAD_DIM` is a template parameter of `launchFusedMuseSpark`, so the runtime `switch (head_dim)` is a single `DISPATCH_ROPE_T(HEAD_DIM)` and each unit's symbols carry their own head_dim - plus the API unit dispatching to `..._typed<64/128/256>`. A `head_dim` outside 64/128/256 still reports "unsupported head_dim".

**How the file got this big.** It has no growth history: #62132 landed the whole op five days ago, in one TU, as 1 `__global__` with 8 templates and `head_dim` {64,128,256} x `heads_per_group` {1,2,4} x rope type {fp32, scalar_t} - 18 configurations per dtype pair, plus the fp8-output arms. Nothing has been added to it since.

So its 478 s at 9 archs is the cost of that configuration set on day one, not of accretion; this PR splits it into 3 units.

### Left to do

- [ ] Cross-check with #63364: this branch is based on `main`, so its 9-arch numbers are taken with the int4 split merged in; on `main` alone the change is neutral (1241 s vs 1263 s).
- [x] Run `tests/kernels/test_fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert.py` on this revision (it covers head_dim 64/128/256 through the public entry, i.e. through the new forward). Done, see *Runtime check*.

files.patch:
@@ -457,7 +457,14 @@ if(VLLM_GPU_LANG STREQUAL "CUDA" OR VLLM_GPU_LANG STREQUAL "HIP")
     "csrc/quantization/w8a8/fp8/per_token_group_quant.cu"
     "csrc/quantization/gptq/q_gemm.cu"
     "csrc/pos_encoding_kernels.cu"
-    "csrc/fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_kernel.cu"
+    # Fused MUSE-Spark qknorm/rope/kv-insert is instantiated one unit per
+    # head_dim: with the whole op in one unit it is one of the longest compiles
+    # of a 9-arch build. _api keeps the public entry point and forwards on
+    # head_dim.
+    "csrc/fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_api.cu"
+    "csrc/fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_hd64.cu"
+    "csrc/fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_hd128.cu"
+    "csrc/fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_hd256.cu"
     "csrc/fused_qknorm_rope_kernel.cu"
     "csrc/fused_minimax_m3_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_kernel.cu"
     "csrc/layernorm_kernels.cu"

@@ -0,0 +1,27 @@
+// Public entry point of the fused MUSE-Spark qknorm/rope/kv-insert op. The
+// kernels are instantiated one unit per head_dim (see
+// fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_hd<n>.cu); this unit only dispatches,
+// so it includes the declaration header rather than the kernel header.
+#include "fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_entry.h"
+
+void fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert(VLLM_MUSE_SPARK_ENTRY_SIG) {
+  switch (head_dim) {
+    case 64:
+      return fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_typed<64>(
+          qkv, positions, num_heads, num_kv_heads, head_dim, eps, cos_sin_cache,
+          rotary_dim, slot_mapping, kv_cache, block_size, kv_cache_dtype,
+          k_scale, v_scale, q_fp8_out, q_scale);
+    case 128:
+      return fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_typed<128>(
+          qkv, positions, num_heads, num_kv_heads, head_dim, eps, cos_sin_cache,
+          rotary_dim, slot_mapping, kv_cache, block_size, kv_cache_dtype,
+          k_scale, v_scale, q_fp8_out, q_scale);
+    case 256:
+      return fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_typed<256>(
+          qkv, positions, num_heads, num_kv_heads, head_dim, eps, cos_sin_cache,
+          rotary_dim, slot_mapping, kv_cache, block_size, kv_cache_dtype,
+          k_scale, v_scale, q_fp8_out, q_scale);
+    default:
+      STD_TORCH_CHECK(false, "unsupported head_dim: ", head_dim);
+  }
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,48 @@
+/*
+ * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+ * SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+ *
+ * Declaration of the fused MUSE-Spark qknorm/rope/kv-insert entry, one
+ * instantiation per head_dim. The API unit dispatches on head_dim and only
+ * needs this header; the kernels stay in
+ * fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_kernel.cuh, which the per-head_dim
+ * units instantiate through VLLM_MUSE_SPARK_ENTRY below.
+ *
+ * The parameter list is spelled once here and reused by the declaration, the
+ * `extern template` lines and the explicit instantiations, so the three cannot
+ * drift apart into different overloads.
+ */
+
+#pragma once
+
+#include <cstdint>
+#include <optional>
+#include <string>
+
+#include "torch_utils.h"
+
+#define VLLM_MUSE_SPARK_ENTRY_SIG                                             \
+  torch::stable::Tensor &qkv, torch::stable::Tensor const &positions,         \
+      int64_t num_heads, int64_t num_kv_heads, int64_t head_dim, double eps,  \
+      std::optional<torch::stable::Tensor> cos_sin_cache, int64_t rotary_dim, \
+      std::optional<torch::stable::Tensor> slot_mapping,                      \
+      std::optional<torch::stable::Tensor> kv_cache, int64_t block_size,      \
+      const std::string &kv_cache_dtype,                                      \
+      std::optional<torch::stable::Tensor> k_scale,                           \
+      std::optional<torch::stable::Tensor> v_scale,                           \
+      std::optional<torch::stable::Tensor> q_fp8_out,                         \
+      std::optional<torch::stable::Tensor> q_scale
+
+// One instantiation per supported head_dim; EXT is `extern` to name an
+// instantiation that another unit provides, and empty in the unit that
+// provides it.
+#define VLLM_MUSE_SPARK_ENTRY(EXT, HD)                                \
+  EXT template void fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_typed<HD>( \
+      VLLM_MUSE_SPARK_ENTRY_SIG)
+
+template <int HEAD_DIM>
+void fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_typed(VLLM_MUSE_SPARK_ENTRY_SIG);
+
+VLLM_MUSE_SPARK_ENTRY(extern, 64);
+VLLM_MUSE_SPARK_ENTRY(extern, 128);
+VLLM_MUSE_SPARK_ENTRY(extern, 256);

@@ -0,0 +1,4 @@
+// Instantiates the fused MUSE-Spark qknorm/rope/kv-insert kernels for
+// head_dim == 128 only; see fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_entry.h.
+#include "fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_kernel.cuh"
+VLLM_MUSE_SPARK_ENTRY(, 128);

@@ -0,0 +1,4 @@
+// Instantiates the fused MUSE-Spark qknorm/rope/kv-insert kernels for
+// head_dim == 256 only; see fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_entry.h.
+#include "fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_kernel.cuh"
+VLLM_MUSE_SPARK_ENTRY(, 256);

@@ -0,0 +1,4 @@
+// Instantiates the fused MUSE-Spark qknorm/rope/kv-insert kernels for
+// head_dim == 64 only; see fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_entry.h.
+#include "fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_kernel.cuh"
+VLLM_MUSE_SPARK_ENTRY(, 64);

issue_comments.body:
### PR Pundit review

(Testing PR Pundit Code Review agent. Not all comments may be relevant. This is a one-time automated pass: please address what is useful, no need to request a re-review. Reach out to @peymanr for suggestions and feedback.)

| # | | Finding | Where |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 🔴 | Lane-dependent template body risks ODR violation across units | `csrc/fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_kernel.cu:579` |
| 2 | 🟠 | No single-process test covers all three head_dims on split build | `tests/kernels/test_fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert.py:251` |
| 3 | 🔵 | Op signature hand-duplicated with no shared declaration | `csrc/fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_api.cu:12` |
| 4 | 🔵 | Dead LANE==0 fallback path is never built or validated | `csrc/fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_kernel.cu:576` |
| 5 | 🔵 | Include-only kernel keeps .cu extension and public symbol | `csrc/fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_kernel.cu` |
| 6 | 🔵 | Macro name `LANE` misdescribes head-dim selection | `csrc/fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_kernel.cu:575` |

#### 1. 🔴 Blocking: Lane-dependent template body risks ODR violation across units
`csrc/fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_kernel.cu:579`

`launchFusedMuseSpark<scalar_t,...>` has external linkage (not in the anonymous namespace) and its `if constexpr` body varies per TU via `FUSED_MUSE_SPARK_LANE`, so the linker keeps one arbitrary weak copy for all three suffixed entry points. Two of three head_dims may hit `STD_TORCH_CHECK(false, "head_dim N not compiled")` depending on link order and inlining. Make the function depend on `head_dim` as a template parameter or place it in an anonymous namespace.

**How it is reached:** MuseSpark model forward (vllm/models/muse_spark/amd/model.py:588, gated at :545-554 on head_dim in (64,128,256), bf16/fp16, supported kv cache) or tests/kernels/test_fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert.py -> vllm._custom_ops.fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert -> torch.ops._C op -> _api.cu switch -> fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_hd{128,256} -> vllm::muse_spark_fused_ops::launchFusedMuseSpark<st,CACHE_T,KV_DTYPE> (weak symbol, linker keeps one lane's copy, likely hd64 by CMake order) -> STD_TORCH_CHECK(false, "head_dim N not compiled") at kernel.cu:579+

**Who is affected:** Every CUDA or ROCm build of _C: the fused MuseSpark op fails at runtime for every head_dim whose lane copy the linker dropped (two of 64/128/256), so the MuseSpark model's fused path and the kernel tests break.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

#### 2. 🟠 Should fix: No single-process test covers all three head_dims on split build
`tests/kernels/test_fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert.py:251`

`launchFusedMuseSpark<scalar_t, cache_t, kv_dt>` is now implicitly instantiated with a different, `FUSED_MUSE_SPARK_LANE`-dependent body in each of `_hd64`/`_hd128`/`_hd256`.cu under one mangled name. Unless it is inlined, the linker keeps one body, and the other head_dims hit `head_dim N not compiled` at runtime. Only `test_fused_query_quant_matches_separate_quant` covers head_dim 128/256; the other tests use `HEAD_DIM=64`. That test is skipped on ROCm GPUs whose `fp8_dtype()` is FNUZ (gfx942/MI300), so there a broken build passes the whole file. Add head_dim 64/128/256 (and an unsupported head_dim) coverage that does not depend on E4M3FN Q output, or give the lane functions internal linkage.

**Who is affected:** ROCm FNUZ GPUs (MI300/gfx942) running this test file; on CUDA and E4M3FN ROCm the line-251 test still covers all three head_dims.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

**Related past reviews:** [#42893](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/42893) on `csrc/fused_deepseek_v4_qnorm_rope_kv_insert_kernel.cu`

#### 3. 🔵 Nit: Op signature hand-duplicated with no shared declaration
`csrc/fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_api.cu:12`

`fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_api.cu` hand-copies the 16-parameter op signature four times (three `_hdN` prototypes plus the entry definition) and does not include `csrc/ops.h`, which already declares the entry. If the signature changes in `kernel.cu`/`ops.h` but not here, a mismatch just creates a different C++ overload. The error then appears only when the `_hdN` or `torch_bindings.cpp` symbol is resolved (link, or `vllm._C` import), not at compile time. The `#define`-before-`#include` renaming in each `hdN.cu` is confined to that unit and does not touch vLLM's `ops.h` (`kernel.cu` includes only torch's `stable/ops.h`). Consider sharing one parameter-list macro or including `ops.h`, as `csrc/rocm/attention_dispatch.cu` does with `ATTN_ENTRY`.

**Who is affected:** Developers who later change this op's signature; no runtime effect on users of the current code.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

#### 4. 🔵 Nit: Dead LANE==0 fallback path is never built or validated
`csrc/fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_kernel.cu:576`

The `FUSED_MUSE_SPARK_LANE` default-0 fallback, the `LANE == 0 ||` guard clauses, and the comment describe a mode the build never uses, and a typo'd macro silently compiles a TU rejecting every head_dim at runtime. Replace the fallback with `#ifndef ... #error` at file scope, add a `static_assert`, and drop the `== 0 ||` clauses.

**Who is affected:** Maintainers of the MUSE-Spark kernel sources; no runtime effect in any shipped build configuration.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

**Related past reviews:** [#37503](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/37503) on `CMakeLists.txt`

#### 5. 🔵 Nit: Include-only kernel keeps .cu extension and public symbol
`csrc/fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_kernel.cu`

The now include-only kernel file keeps its `.cu` extension and still defines the unsuffixed `fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert`; re-adding it to a source list would duplicate that symbol. Rename it to `.cuh` or add `#error` when `FUSED_MUSE_SPARK_LANE` is undefined, matching the attention split.

**Who is affected:** Only a future maintainer who adds `csrc/fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_kernel.cu` back to a CMake source list; today's build is unaffected.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

**Related past reviews:** [#37376](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/37376) on `csrc/fused_qknorm_rope_kernel.cu`

#### 6. 🔵 Nit: Macro name `LANE` misdescribes head-dim selection
`csrc/fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_kernel.cu:575`

`FUSED_MUSE_SPARK_LANE` misuses 'lane', which elsewhere (`ELTS_PER_LANE`, etc.) means a thread within a warp; here it selects the head_dim the TU instantiates. Rename to something like `FUSED_MUSE_SPARK_HEAD_DIM` to match the `_hd<n>` suffixes and CMake comment.

**Who is affected:** Maintainers reading or extending the per-head_dim split of the fused MUSE-Spark op; it has no runtime or build effect.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

<sub>Shared from a pilot of [PR Pundit](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/pr_pundit), an agentic code reviewer that builds and tests the change and reads the project's past reviews. Reviewed at `31de254f`; findings checked and posted by @peymanr; points already raised on this PR are left out.</sub>
